question: Does R10AM lack a foot-only support envelope, and does its conditional height objective or an interior joint margin obstruct a bounded upward support-transfer target?

population.selection: All original observations in order; terminal sample descriptive only.

contact_analysis.source: Original detection-frame contact source, independently replayed before use.
envelopes: all four callback cap centers, including unloaded feet
positive normal-impulse actual foot contact points
positive normal-impulse actual all-body floor contact points
contact_analysis.measurement: Euclidean horizontal distance from measured COM projection to convex hull; zero inside. Empty hull returns null. Points/segments handled explicitly.
contact_analysis.load: Sum original normal impulses by foot/nonfoot and body; ratio of nonfoot to total. This is measured contact impulse allocation, not static load or a force model.
contact_analysis.motion: Sum virtual proposals separately from measured net torso translation; virtual sums are not trajectory predictions.

model_algorithm.candidate_population: Original 90 torso candidates, exact original anchoring and free-foot placement algorithms, unchanged joint speed 4 rad/s and Cartesian speed 0.1 m/s.
model_algorithm.height_objective: When height_goal=true, use the original 0.92-leg-height torso goal whenever any foot bears, including partial bearing. Other original cost terms unchanged.
model_algorithm.margin: When nonzero, reject a candidate unless all targets are inside original hip/knee limits by 0.02 rad. No target clipping or physical predicate change.
model_algorithm.selection: First strictly cost-decreasing candidate under the declared variant cost, epsilon 1e-12. Record every no-candidate or no-improvement refusal.
model_algorithm.validation: Original variant must exactly reconstruct retained candidate counts, selection, and targets. Check selected targets by independent FK, original speed limits, anchor residual <=0.0005m, unsupported endpoints nonascending, and torso-up nondecreasing. Record candidates before and after margin filtering.
model_algorithm.exclusions: No model propagation, body-force prediction, collision-free path claim, contact acquisition prediction or physical controller selection.

decision_rules: Retain all four variants, all 600 inputs and all refusals; no search over margins or weights after results.
A feasible target is only local geometry; original nonfoot contacts can block actual movement.
A margin-only patch cannot be called sufficient without a support-transfer route.
No physical population, source-key renewal, controller mutation, cap change or deadline change.
